title: A phase-field model for the Verigin problem: weak solutions and sharp-interface limit
summary: We introduce a novel phase-field model approximating the Verigin problem with phase transition. For fixed interface thickness $\varepsilon>0$, we construct weak solutions through a time-discrete variational scheme combining a Wasserstein minimizing-movement for the density with Schätzle's selection procedure for the phase field, which yields strong compactness and an almost-minimizing property. We then investigate the sharp-interface limit $\varepsilon \downarrow0$.
